title: RoomListStoreV3 Filter Infrastructure
mini_srs: This milestone implements the filter infrastructure for RoomListStoreV3. It introduces the skip-list filter abstraction with FavouriteFilter as the reference implementation (7ff1fd2), then adds primary filters (UnreadFilter, PeopleFilter, RoomsFilter in 8295750) and secondary filters (InvitesFilter, MentionsFilter, LowPriorityFilter in 4797644). The store is integrated with SpaceStore (af47690), sorting preferences are persisted (f4b03a1), and unread filter edge cases are handled (0dc295e, 3f1e56b). Bug fix da87bbe prevents left rooms from appearing in the list. Setting to hide invite room avatars is added (66d9d71). Testing is provided via unit tests in each commit.

title: Room List V3 ViewModel Foundation
mini_srs: This sub-milestone establishes the ViewModel foundation for Room List V3. The ViewModel foundation (e9a3625) establishes reactive room list updates and room opening functionality. Primary filter support (fd91e78) and secondary filter support (3f3fba9) expose filter state to the UI. Sorting functionality (9fb52e9) provides room list resorting. Filter reset behavior (3a39486) handles primary/secondary filter interaction. Message preview toggle (d88776e) and MessagePreviewViewModel (550f529) add message preview functionality.

title: Room List V3 UI Components
mini_srs: This sub-milestone delivers the UI components for Room List V3. Virtualized flat list rendering (90cc44b) provides the base list component. Primary filter pills (20d8abf) add filter UI. Room item options menu (f3dbe81) adds hover menu with favorite/invite/leave actions. Selection decoration (3587161) highlights the active room. Visual polish commits (24d9a17, d8ecb63) improve styling. Space menu fix (ceba762) and naming update (c31f552) improve UX.

title: Room List V3 Room Behavior and Display
mini_srs: This sub-milestone completes Room List V3 with room behavior and display features. Empty state (7de54a3) shows contextual messages when the list is empty. Active room tracking (839329b) tracks the current room index. Sticky room behavior (b541228) keeps the active room visible during list updates. Notification badges (bbd798e) show unread counts. Visual polish (6ae11da) improves spacing and padding.

title: React 19 JSX Import Migration
mini_srs: This milestone delivers React 19 compatibility by migrating JSX imports. The seed commit (05df321) adds explicit JSX imports to 213 files to comply with React 19's new JSX transform requirements. Additional react import updates (a6ae04b) complete the migration. The changes affect core components in src/components/, accessibility utilities, and authentication flows. Note: fac9828 and 7970b96 removed due to circular dependency with milestone_seed_3f47487_1.

title: React DOM Rendering Modernization for Message Content
mini_srs: This milestone modernizes React DOM rendering by replacing legacy patterns of nesting React trees and DOM manipulation with proper component-based rendering. The main commit (3f47487) creates a new src/renderer/ module with pill.tsx, utils.tsx, code-block.tsx, and link-tooltip.tsx while removing deprecated utilities. Ancestor commit 0d28df0 centralizes PushProcessor usage. Legacy context avoidance (5b1be70) and getDerivedStateFromProps fix (a32704a) complete the modernization. Note: 209ab59 and 59e591c removed due to circular dependency with other milestones.

title: Key Storage Toggle for Encryption Settings
mini_srs: This milestone adds a key storage toggle UI to the Encryption settings tab allowing users to enable or disable server-side key backup storage. The implementation creates KeyStoragePanel.tsx and DeleteKeyStoragePanel.tsx components with a ViewModel pattern (KeyStoragePanelViewModel.ts) for managing key backup state. It modifies EncryptionUserSettingsTab.tsx to integrate the new panels. Documentation improvements (cdd2622) and analytics constants (f9a0bb2) are included. Changes are verified through Playwright tests and unit tests.

title: Identity Reset Protection UX Enhancement
mini_srs: This milestone enhances security UX around identity management. It prevents users from accidentally triggering multiple concurrent identity reset operations (56c7fc1) with loading state management and InlineSpinner. It also prevents bypassing device verification in force-verify mode (170dcd1). The UX text is improved to use 'Dismiss' instead of 'Ok' for pinned identity changes (d0c1610). These changes protect users from key loss and verification bypass.

title: SSO Pickle Key Generation and Session Handling
mini_srs: This milestone ensures proper authentication handling. It adds pickle key generation for SSO sessions (fba5938) via loadOrCreatePickleKey() function. It also updates mxLoginWithAccessToken to grab deviceId from /whoami (99ea51c) and fixes token expiry racing with login (102a1dd). These changes ensure proper key persistence and login reliability.

title: Group Call Error Screen Display
mini_srs: This milestone improves group call error handling UX by displaying error screens in group calls instead of failing silently. The RoomViewStore now manages call creation and destruction rather than the CallView component. Changes affect RoomView.tsx CallView.tsx Call.ts RoomViewStore.tsx and related call components. Testing involves verifying error screens appear when call disconnections occur.

title: Simplified Sliding Sync Architecture
mini_srs: This milestone refactors the sliding sync implementation by removing legacy code and simplifying the architecture. It deletes the 391-line SlidingRoomListStore.ts removes the sliding sync proxy lookup and introduces a new feature_simplified_sliding_sync labs flag. Testing involves verifying sliding sync functionality works correctly with native server support.

title: Element Call Bundle Integration for Offline Deployment
mini_srs: This milestone bundles Element Call within Element Web packages enabling offline and bundled deployment of voice and video calling. It removes the external call.element.io URL dependency and adds a Developer.elementCallUrl setting for override. Testing involves verifying bundled Element Call loads correctly and posthog/rageshake integration works when analytics is enabled.

title: Image and Video Hiding Privacy Feature
mini_srs: This milestone adds the ability to hide images and videos after clicking 'show image/video' in the timeline. It introduces a HideActionButton component and useMediaVisible hook for managing media visibility state per-event. The feature modifies MImageBody, MStickerBody, and MVideoBody components to support toggled visibility. Testing includes unit tests for HideActionButton and integration tests.

title: Enhanced Rageshake Error Reporting with Friendly Messages
mini_srs: This milestone improves the rageshake bug report upload experience by providing actionable error information when uploads fail. It introduces a RageshakeError class with structured error codes and policy URLs. The BugReportDialog is updated to display human-readable error messages. Implementation uses fetch API replacing XMLHttpRequest for cleaner async handling.

title: Compound Design System Checkbox Migration
mini_srs: This milestone replaces custom checkbox implementations with Compound Design System CheckboxInput components across 27 files. It removes the legacy StyledCheckbox CSS and class-based component. All checkboxes now have proper accessibility labels. Testing includes Playwright tests verifying checkbox interactions and snapshot updates.

title: Cross-Subsystem Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements
mini_srs: This maintenance milestone addresses various bug fixes: removes buggy tooltip on room intro and homepage (31af8b0), fixes MFileBody fileName handling (89e22e0), fixes startup hang when clock is wound back (f3653ab), hides redacted event notifications (d7730f4), fixes spoiler click handling (bcc4ecf), and increases overscan count for virtualized lists (d5e070b). These fixes improve overall application stability.

title: UI/UX and Accessibility Improvements
mini_srs: This maintenance milestone improves UI/UX and accessibility: adds space below leave room button (b6c8721), moves toggle switch for a11y (8d891cd), fixes button background color (bf6ae73), updates keyboard binding actions (e44ca88), adds flex wrap props (917d53a), adds title attribute for accessibility (435d0f9), and uses outline icon for report button (74da64d).

title: Reply Mentions and Notification API Improvements
mini_srs: This milestone adds new features: implements MSC4142 to remove unintentional mentions in replies (fda6581), adds report room dialog button (e1970df), and improves room notification state API with clearer methods and documentation (a6e8d51). These enhancements improve the user experience and API usability.

title: Infrastructure Maintenance and Code Quality Improvements
mini_srs: This maintenance milestone updates dependencies and infrastructure: TypeScript v5.8.2 update (1770b94), matrix-wysiwyg v2.38.2 update (9d8efac), adds E2E test for quick settings (53065f9), and Localazy translation download (e5d37a3). These changes keep the codebase current and well-tested.
